design_rationale: The following knowledge domains are an engineering taxonomy created to organize the BIS knowledge required to satisfy the SIH PS, rather than official categories defined by the PS text.

domains.name: Indian Standards Specifications & Amendments
domains.description: Technical specifications, codes of practice, test methods, amendments, revisions, and dimensional/chemical limits established under the Bureau of Indian Standards Act.

domains.name: Certification & Conformity Assessment
domains.description: Statutory Quality Control Orders (QCOs), Conformity Assessment Schemes, Product Manuals, and Schemes of Inspection and Testing (SIT).
primary_authorities: Ministry of Consumer Affairs, Food & Public Distribution

domains.name: Testing and Laboratories
domains.description: Prescribed routine, acceptance, and type tests, test parameters, limits, laboratory recognition rules, and directory of accredited BIS & partner test labs.

domains.name: Hallmarking
domains.description: Assaying, purity standards for gold and silver bullion/jewellery, 6-digit Hallmark Unique Identification (HUID), and Assaying & Hallmarking Centres (AHC).

domains.name: Consumer Information & Verification
domains.description: Consumer verification of Standard Marks (ISI Mark, CRS Logo, Hallmark), BIS Care application workflows, licence validation, and grievance redressal for spurious marks.

domains.name: General BIS Services & Procedures
domains.description: Statutory definitions, portal workflows (Manakonline, e-BIS), foreign manufacturer certification (FMCS), simplified procedures, and general advisory services.
